message.content:
Found the bug! On line 10, `getUserProfile(user)` is called without checking if `user` is null/undefined. When `db.users.findById` returns `undefined` (user not found), the function tries to access `.email` on undefined.

The fix is to add a null check before calling `getUserProfile`.

function.name: Edit

message.content: The fix adds a null check on line 10. If the user is not found in the database, it now returns a proper 404 response instead of crashing with a 500 error.
